So parent gets stuck DD against TFT after initial defection because it retaliates and never recovers? Need improve recovery/forgiveness against TFT to get mutual cooperation."
STRATEGY: Parent is a conditional cooperator that retaliates and never forgives, getting stuck in DD/alternation against TFT after initial defections. The trace simulates probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and proposes adding forgiveness, early cooperation, and safe testing to exploit unconditional cooperators while recovering against retaliatory strategies.
